title: 一个按键控制两颗 LED
summary: 按下按键，两条并联的 LED 支路同时点亮：开关要放在分岔点之前。
description: +5 V → 按键 → 结点 SWOUT；从 SWOUT 分出两条支路：220 Ω + 红色 LED、220 Ω + 黄色 LED，都回到 GND。松开按键两颗都灭，按下两颗都亮。

cards.title: 一个总开关
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**：一个按键，后面分成两条 LED 支路。

cards.title: 开关放在哪里，就管哪一段
text: - 开关串在哪条路上，就只管那条路。想让一个按键**同时**管两条支路，它必须放在两条支路**分岔之前**。
- 按键的输出端就是结点 **SWOUT**：两个电阻的一只脚都插在这一列。

cards.title: 搭好，量一量
text: - 按键横跨凹槽放在 e 行；它右边那一列（上下两段都算）就是 SWOUT。
- 两条支路各回各的 GND（用电源模块时，下方的 bn 轨也是 GND）。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **总开关在分岔前，分开关在支路里。** 家里的总闸和每个房间的开关就是这样排的。
- 两条支路并联：按下后它们两端电压相同，电流各自由自己的电阻和 LED 决定。

en.title: One button, two LEDs
en.summary: Press the button and two parallel LED branches light together: the switch goes before the fork.
en.description: +5 V → button → node SWOUT; from SWOUT two branches: 220 Ω + red LED and 220 Ω + yellow LED, both back to GND. Released, both are off; pressed, both are on.
hints: The button straddles the trench in row e; the column to its right (both halves count) is SWOUT.
One leg of each resistor goes into the SWOUT column.
With the power module, the lower bn rail is GND as well.

cards.title: One master switch
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**: one button, then two LED branches.

cards.title: A switch controls the stretch it sits in
text: - A switch in series with a path controls only that path. For one button to control **both** branches **at once**, it must sit **before the fork**.
- The button's output is node **SWOUT**: one leg of each resistor goes into that column.

cards.title: Build it, measure it
text: - The button straddles the trench in row e; the column to its right (both halves) is SWOUT.
- Each branch goes back to GND (with the power module, the lower bn rail is GND too).

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Master switch before the fork, branch switches in the branches.** That is how a home's main switch and the room switches are arranged.
- The two branches are in parallel: pressed, they have the same voltage across them, and each current is set by its own resistor and LED.

measurements.ask: Button pressed: the red LED's current (click it and look at Properties)
Button pressed: the yellow LED's current
From your two readings: the current through the button
measurements.explain: Both branch currents pass through the button first, so its current is their sum (KCL).

measurements.ask: 按下按键：红色 LED 的电流（单击它看「属性」）
按下按键：黄色 LED 的电流
用你的两个读数算：流过按键的电流
measurements.explain: 两条支路的电流都要先经过按键，所以按键里的电流是两者之和（KCL）。

hints: 按键横跨凹槽放在 e 行；它右边那一列（上下两段都算）就是 SWOUT。
两个电阻的一只脚都插在 SWOUT 那一列。
用电源模块的话，下方的 bn 轨也是 GND。
